newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management says to buy Goldin.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management says to buy Goldin.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said it signed a binding letter of intent to purchase all of the scrap metal-related business operations and assets, excluding real estate, of Goldin Industries Inc and related businesses.
Shareholders of the Goldin companies will receive $7.15 million in cash and 112,500 shares of Metal's common stock.

The Goldin companies, based in Gulfport, Miss., operate five facilities, including one outside New Orleans, two in Mobile, Ala., and two in Gulfport, and principally process industrial ferrous and non-ferrous metals, Metal said.
